result.title: When accuracy hides risk: risk-controlled confirmation of the critical view of safety under expert disagreement
result.summary: Automated assessment of the critical view of safety (CVS) in laparoscopic cholecystectomy has advanced rapidly, but a deployed check must decide, before the first clip, whether to confirm CVS. The standard rule calibrates a threshold so that false confirmations are rare on average. We show that this rule concentrates its errors on disputed videos, which one of three expert raters judged sufficient, and that the failure is structural. When reference labels are votes of a panel sampled from a larger expert pool, the rule that maximizes sensitivity at a fixed average false-confirmation rate also maximizes false confirmation of disputed videos, and for recognizers that recover expert judgement with less noise this rate rises with accuracy. We propose certified confirmation, a risk-controlled monitoring rule whose threshold is selected by multiple testing so that, with probability at least 1 - δ, false confirmation is at most α overall, among disputed videos, within vendor and country groups, and before CVS is visible, using disputed labels only to calibrate. In a pre-specified, hash-locked evaluation on the 300 test videos (18 countries) of the SAGES CVS Challenge, standard calibration falsely confirmed 8 of 39 disputed videos (0.21; one-sided p = 0.037 against α = 0.10), whereas certified confirmation confirmed 2 (one-sided 95% upper bound 0.15). On development data, protection held for vendor and country groups left out of calibration. The cost was confirming 10% rather than 35% of sufficient videos on time. Average accuracy hides this risk; disputed cases must be protected explicitly.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出腹腔镜胆囊切除术中「安全关键视野」自动判定的常规阈值校准会把假确认集中于专家评分有争议的病例，并在标签视为专家池投票的设定下证明该失败是结构性的；随后提出以多重检验选阈值的风险受控确认规则，在 SAGES CVS Challenge 300 例测试集上按预注册方案验证争议病例与厂商、国家分组的保护效果，代价是及时确认率由 35% 降至 10%。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「在专家分歧下对确认动作给出风险受控、分组与证据尚未出现前即须满足的保证」这一停止/确认准则，可能为 LVR 中 STOP 决策与证据充分性的评价提供可核查的统计框架；但场景为医学影像判定而非视觉-语言推理，迁移性需自行核查。
